choices.name: warehouseExchangeChoice
choices.choiceText: Incisive Exchange (same model, shipped from our stock)

Flow.description:
Initiates a scanner exchange for an account. User selects the scanner being replaced, and the flow creates an Exchange Onboarding and Pending Device for the hardware team to fulfill.
2026-06-11: BN- Specify record type for onboarding creation

formulas.name: mfgCompleteMessage
formulas.expression: IF(ISBLANK({!mfgNewSerialNumber}), "Serial " & {!getOldAsset.SerialNumber} & " has been retired. Any accessories on the old scanner have been moved to the new one. The replacement is Deployed; its serial number is not yet known and will show up on the Scanners Awaiting Serial Number list view until it's filled in.", "Serial " & {!getOldAsset.SerialNumber} & " has been retired and replaced with serial " & {!mfgNewSerialNumber} & ". Any accessories on the old scanner have been moved to the new one.")

formulas.name: mfgNewAssetNotes
formulas.expression: IF(ISBLANK({!mfgNotes}), "Manufacturer-direct exchange - replaces serial " & {!getOldAsset.SerialNumber}, "Manufacturer-direct exchange - replaces serial " & {!getOldAsset.SerialNumber} & ". " & {!mfgNotes})

formulas.name: mfgOldAssetNotes
formulas.expression: IF(ISBLANK({!mfgNewSerialNumber}), IF(ISBLANK({!mfgNotes}), "Manufacturer-direct exchange - replacement serial not yet known", "Manufacturer-direct exchange - replacement serial not yet known. " & {!mfgNotes}), IF(ISBLANK({!mfgNotes}), "Manufacturer-direct exchange - replaced by serial " & {!mfgNewSerialNumber}, "Manufacturer-direct exchange - replaced by serial " & {!mfgNewSerialNumber} & ". " & {!mfgNotes}))

formulas.name: onboardingName
formulas.expression: {!getAccount.Name} & " Exchange - " & TEXT(YEAR(TODAY())) & "-" & IF(MONTH(TODAY()) < 10, "0" & TEXT(MONTH(TODAY())), TEXT(MONTH(TODAY()))) & "-" & IF(DAY(TODAY()) < 10, "0" & TEXT(DAY(TODAY())), TEXT(DAY(TODAY())))

Flow.label: Account - Screenflow - Exchange Scanner

fields.name: instructionText
fields.fieldText: Select one or more scanners to exchange.

fields.name: mfgFaultText
fields.fieldText:
The exchange could not be completed. Nothing was saved - the old scanner is still active and no new asset was created.

Error detail: {!$Flow.FaultMessage}

If this mentions a duplicate serial number, it may be one of the accessories on the old scanner sharing a placeholder serial with an unrelated record elsewhere in the org (a known, separate issue) rather than the serial number you entered for the replacement. Contact RevOps if you're not sure.

fields.name: mfgScannerInstructionText
fields.fieldText:
Select the scanner that was exchanged directly with the manufacturer.

This is for exchanges that never went through our warehouse - e.g. a broken unit sent straight back to 3Shape or another manufacturer, with a replacement shipped straight to the practice. Select one scanner.

fields.name: noAssetsText
fields.fieldText: No assets were found on this account. An exchange can only be initiated for accounts with existing scanner assets.

fields.name: notesInstructionText
fields.fieldText: Optionally add notes for each scanner explaining why the unit is being exchanged.
